tool.name: Chimera.slayer
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat && #if $alignment.source == "self": #if $alignment.name: ln -s '$alignment.name' alignment.name.dat && #end if #if $alignment.group: ln -s '$alignment.group' alignment.group.dat && #end if #if $alignment.count: ln -s '$alignment.count' alignment.count.dat && #end if #else: ln -s '$alignment.reference' alignment.reference.dat && #end if
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat") #if $alignment.source == "self": #silent $mothur_args.append("reference=self") #if $alignment.name: #silent $mothur_args.append("name=alignment.name.dat") #end if #if $alignment.group: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=alignment.group.dat") #end if #if $alignment.count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=alignment.count.dat") #end if #else: #silent $mothur_args.append("reference=alignment.reference.dat") #end if #if $options.setby == "user": #silent $mothur_args.append("window=" + str($options.window)) #silent $mothur_args.append("increment=" + str($options.increment)) #silent $mothur_args.append("match=" + str($options.match)) #silent $mothur_args.append("mismatch=" + str($options.mismatch)) #silent $mothur_args.append("numwanted=" + str($options.numwanted)) #silent $mothur_args.append("parents=" + str($options.parents)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minsim=" + str($options.minsim)) #silent $mothur_args.append("mincov=" + str($options.mincov)) #silent $mothur_args.append("iters=" + str($options.iters)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minbs=" + str($options.minbs)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minsnp=" + str($options.minsnp)) #silent $mothur_args.append("divergence=" + str($options.divergence)) #silent $mothur_args.append("realign=" + str($options.realign)) #silent $mothur_args.append("trim=" + str($options.trim)) #silent $mothur_args.append("split=" + str($options.split)) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("dereplicate=" + str($dereplicate)) #silent $mothur_args.append("removechimeras=" + str($removechimeras))
echo 'chimera.slayer(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log #if str($alignment.source) == "self" and $alignment.count and str($removechimeras) == "true": ## mothur skips remove.seqs when no chimeras are found, so no chimeras count table is ## written. In that case the count table is unchanged and the input can be reused; ## copying it also avoids handing Galaxy an empty count table, which it cannot parse. && if [ ! -s fasta.slayer.count_table ]; then cp alignment.count.dat fasta.slayer.count_table; fi #end if

param.label: fasta - Candiate Sequences

param.name: source
param.label: Select Reference Template from
param.option: Self - Use abundant sequences from the input Candiate Sequences fasta

param.label: reference - Select an alignment database
reference - Reference to align with
count - Count file
names - Sequences Names
group - Sequences Name reference
param.help: use the more abundant sequences from the same sample to check the query sequence

param.name: setby
param.label: Slayer Options
ksize - kmer size
param.help: size of the kmers used to search the reference for candidate parents (default 7)

param.label: window - Window size for searching for chimeras (default 50)
increment - Increment for window slide on each iteration (default 5)
match - Reward matched bases (default 5)
mismatch - Penalty for mismatched bases (default -4)
numwanted - Number of potential parents to to compare with query sequence (default 15)
parents - Number of potential parents to investigate from the numwanted best matches
minsim - Minimum similarity % between the query and parent (default 90)
mincov - Minimum coverage % of closest matches in reference and the query (default 70)
iters - Number of bootstrap iterations to try (default 1000)
minbs - Minimum bootstrap support % for calling a sequence chimeric (default 90)
minsnp - Percent of SNPs to sample on each side of breakpoint for computing bootstrap support (default 10)
divergence - Divergence cutoff for chimera determination (default 1.007)
realign - realign the query against the candidate parents
trim - include chimeric sequences trimmed to their longest piece
split - detect tri- and quadmeras
param.help: if a sequence comes back as non-chimeric, mothur will test the two sides to see if they are chimeric.

param.name: dereplicate
param.label: dereplicate - remove chimeric sequences from all groups
param.help: If parameter is false, then if one group finds the seqeunce to be chimeric, then all groups find it to be chimeric

param.name: removechimeras
param.label: removechimeras - remove chimeric sequences from the fasta
param.help: When set to true (the mothur default), the chimeric sequences are removed from the output fasta file and the other files are kept consistent

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The chimera.slayer_ command identifies putative chimeras using the slayer approach.
ChimeraSlayer_ is a chimeric sequence detection utility, compatible with near-full length Sanger sequences and shorter 454-FLX sequences (~500 bp).
Chimera Slayer involves the following series of steps that operate to flag chimeric 16S rRNA sequences:
(A) the ends of a query sequence are searched against an included database of reference chimera-free 16S sequences to identify potential parents of a chimera; (B) candidate parents of a chimera are selected as those that form a branched best scoring alignment to the NAST-formatted query sequence; (C) the NAST alignment of the query sequence is improved in a 'chimera-aware' profile-based NAST realignment to the selected reference parent sequences; and (D) an evolutionary framework is used to flag query sequences found to exhibit greater sequence homology to an in silico chimera formed between any two of the selected reference parent sequences.
Note: It is not recommended to blindly discard all sequences flagged as chimeras. Some may represent naturally formed chimeras that do not represent PCR artifacts. Sequences flagged may warrant further investigation.
.. _ChimeraSlayer: https://doi.org/10.1101/gr.112730.110 .. _chimera.slayer: https://mothur.org/wiki/chimera.slayer/
